verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 'variants' explicitly for A/B and multivariate testing (unleash-docs-8) and has 'impact metrics' that can gate/automate rollout progression based on threshold metrics (unleash-docs-14, unleash-docs-22, unleash-docs-29), giving PMs some data-driven feedback loop on flag variations. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated experimentation dashboard, statistical significance/winner-declaration reporting, or goal-metric comparison across variants akin to a full A/B testing suite. Missing for 10: statistical significance engine, experiment results/winner dashboard, and metric-goal configuration UI tied directly to variant performance.
